# Configuration selection
Run `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` from the repository root.
A present override wins; otherwise use the default value.

# Repository instructions
Keep this file and README.md unchanged. Reuse existing regression tests and preserve unrelated behavior. No dependencies or network are needed.

def choose_value(key, overrides, defaults):
    return overrides.get(key) or defaults.get(key)

task.prompt: Fix choose_value so a present override wins even when its value is falsy. Preserve fallback for an absent key. Reuse the failing test_false_override and extend the regression coverage; keep the existing guidance unchanged.

checks: Present False, zero, empty string and None overrides remain their exact values; missing keys use defaults.
Both input mappings remain unchanged, including unrelated keys.
Retain the three ordinary baseline test methods and verify the named false-override regression fails before the fix and passes after it.
Do not modify human guidance, create native instruction files, install dependencies or use the network.
